title: Work continued after a stop-work order
explanation: ECB violation 39553409Z (2026-04-23, on the site) cites work contrary to a stop-work order (28-207.2.2). Its own text refers to the earlier order; no separate stop-work record dated before it was found. This sequence calls for a check of what was done while the order stood.

title: Nothing recorded for 21 days after an adjacent-protection violation
explanation: ECB violation 39552071X (2026-03-20, on the site) concerns protection of adjacent property. No DOB record on that lot is dated in the 21 days after it; the next is dated 2026-04-23. The gap is a prompt to confirm the protection was put in place, not a finding that it was not.
